Package org.eclipse.spi.net4j

package org.eclipse.spi.net4j
Server service provider interfaces and useful base implementations for the Net4j transport layer.
  • Class
    Description
    Acceptor
    Manages a listening Net4j transport endpoint and the connectors accepted through it.
    Acceptor.ConnectorPreparer
     
    AcceptorFactory
    Creates acceptor implementations for the Net4j acceptor extension point.
    Channel
    Implements a logical Net4j channel that sends and receives buffers through a channel multiplexer and dispatches received data to its configured receiver.
    ChannelContainer
    Provides container support for channels.
    ChannelMultiplexer
    Implements the shared channel-multiplexing machinery for a connector or acceptor, routing buffers between logical channels and the underlying transport while managing channel registration and lifecycle.
    ClientProtocolFactory
    Creates client-side protocol instances for the Net4j client protocol extension point.
    Connector
    Multiplexes Net4j channels over a physical connection and manages connection establishment, negotiation, authentication, and shutdown.
    ConnectorFactory
    Creates connector implementations for the Net4j connector extension point.
    InternalAcceptor
    Internal acceptor contract that combines the public acceptor API with transport configuration and negotiator support required by Net4j acceptor implementations.
    InternalBuffer
    Internal buffer contract for storage that can be associated with a provider and terminally disposed.
    InternalChannel
    Internal channel contract for managing channel identity, its multiplexer, buffer flow, lifecycle, and queued outgoing buffers.
    InternalChannel.CountersChangedEvent
    An event fired from a channel when one of its statistical counters changed.
    InternalChannel.SendQueueEvent
    An event fired from a channel when a buffer is enqueued or dequeued.
    InternalChannel.SendQueueEvent.Type
    Enumerates the possible send queue event types.
    InternalChannelMultiplexer
    Internal contract for a transport that multiplexes logical channels over a connection and supplies their buffers.
    InternalChannelMultiplexer.BufferMultiplexer
     
    InternalConnector
    Internal connector contract that combines the public connector API with channel multiplexing and negotiator configuration.
    InverseCloseable
    Provides the inverse-close operation used when a resource must be closed from the opposite side of a bidirectional lifecycle relationship.
    MessageConnectionFactory
    Provider SPI for creating a fresh asynchronous message connection for one owning Net4j connector.
    MessageConnector
    Multiplexes logical Net4j channels over an operator supplied asynchronous message connection.
    MessageConnector.IMessageConnection
    A reliable, ordered, bidirectional message connection for complete Net4j frames.
    MessageConnector.IMessageConnection.Listener
    Receives connection readiness, complete inbound messages, writability, and closure.
    MessageConnector.IMessageConnection.SendCallback
    Reports completion of one accepted send.
    Protocol<INFRA_STRUCTURE>
    Provides the common implementation of a Net4j protocol.
    SchedulingConnector
    A connector base for transports that send channel buffers over a shared connection.
    SchedulingConnector.IScheduler
    Schedules channels that have outgoing buffers.
    ServerProtocolFactory
    Creates server-side protocol instances for the Net4j server protocol extension point.
